component.name: Reclaim
component.summary: Recover files from raw disk images

description.p: Scan raw disk images for recoverable photos, documents, archives, audio, and video. Review results, preview supported images, filter by file type, and save selected files to another location.
Reclaim opens the source read-only. Recoverability depends on what has been overwritten and on the source format; review recovered files before relying on them.

The Flatpak edition recovers files from disk images selected through the desktop file picker. Direct access to physical drives requires the native Linux package. Application updates are managed by Flatpak.
